name: Bamiyan Buddhas
description: The Bamiyan Buddhas were two 6th-century monumental statues of standing Buddhas carved into the side of a cliff in the Bamyan valley in the Hazarajat region of central Afghanistan. The statues represented the classic blended style of Gandhara art. (Photo Credit: Wikipedia)

name: Band-e Amir National Park
description: Band-e Amir National Park is Afghanistan's first national park, located in the Bamyan Province. It is a series of six deep blue lakes separated by natural dams made of travertine, a mineral deposit. (Photo Credit: Flickr)

name: Shahr-e Zohak
description: Shahr-e Zohak, also known as The Red City, is an ancient citadel located near Bamyan city. It was built around the 3rd century CE and served as a strategic fortress. (Photo Credit: Wikipedia)

name: Shar-i Gholghola
description: Shar-i Gholghola, meaning 'City of Screams' in Persian, is a ruined ancient city located near Bamyan. It was destroyed by the Mongol Empire in the 13th century. (Photo Credit: Flickr)

name: Bamyan Cultural Center
description: The Bamyan Cultural Center is a modern architectural landmark in Bamyan city, designed to promote cultural exchange and artistic expression. (Photo Credit: Wikipedia)

name: Band-e Amir Dragon Statue
description: The Band-e Amir Dragon Statue is a recent addition to Band-e Amir National Park, depicting a mythical dragon emerging from the depths of the lake. (Photo Credit: Instagram)

name: Zuhak Castle
description: Zuhak Castle is an ancient fortress perched atop a hill overlooking the Bamyan valley. It offers panoramic views of the surrounding landscape. (Photo Credit: Wikipedia)

name: Foladi Valley
description: Foladi Valley is a scenic valley located near Bamyan, known for its lush greenery, meadows, and picturesque landscapes. (Photo Credit: Flickr)

name: Bamyan Silk Road Bazaar
description: The Bamyan Silk Road Bazaar is a bustling market located in the heart of Bamyan city, offering a wide variety of local crafts, souvenirs, and traditional Afghan products. (Photo Credit: Instagram)

name: Bamyan Cultural Festival
description: The Bamyan Cultural Festival is an annual event celebrating the rich cultural heritage of the region, featuring music, dance, food, and art exhibitions. (Photo Credit: Facebook)

name: Qala-e Dokhtar
description: Qala-e Dokhtar, or 'The Maiden's Castle,' is a historic fortress located on a hill overlooking Bamyan city. It dates back to the 10th century and offers stunning views of the surrounding valley. (Photo Credit: Wikipedia)

name: Bamyan Museum
